sections.overview: This West African hairstreak is one of two recognized species in the small genus Dapidodigma.
sections.identification: Males have a pale hindwing patch centered on the cell; in D. demeter it lies above.
sections.habitat: Recorded in forest, dry forest and scrub, often associated with Alchornea.
sections.diet: Its larval food plant is unknown.
sections.behavior: Females were found among plants attended by Oecophylla ants.
sections.reproduction: Larvae and pupae of Dapidodigma are attended by ants.
sections.ecology: Unlike forest-only D. demeter, it also occurs in dry forest and scrub; see its profile.
sections.conservation: No global conservation assessment was located in the sources reviewed.
